title: Parse Users
statement: Implement `solve(payload)`. `payload` is a JSON object string with `name` and `age`. Parse it with the json module. Return `{"name": ..., "age": ...}` when name is a non-empty string and age is an int that is not a bool and is >= 0. Otherwise return the string `error`. Do not use eval.
constraints: bool is not an acceptable age
hints: Reject a name that is not a non-empty string.
Reject an age whose type is not exactly int, and reject negatives. type(True) is bool.
editorial: json.loads understands true as a bool, and bool is a subclass of int, so isinstance(age, int) accepts true. type(age) is int is the check that refuses it. eval would execute text. The parser is the json module.
